findings: H1 2026 group revenue £154.3m (+0.3% vs H1 2025 £153.8m); EBITDA £57.0m (+7.1%); profit before tax £32.7m (−3.8%); profit after tax £24.5m (−4.3%); diluted EPS 6.48p (−3.9%) — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

April slowdown: vending revenue weakened, principally photobooth (−17% Photo.ME vending revenue in April vs prior year) and to a lesser extent laundry (+3.0% Wash.ME in April vs +16.3% for full H1); Board cites cautious consumer environment, especially France (weaker confidence, geopolitical/Middle East uncertainty) — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Wash.ME H1 vending revenue +16.3% to £54.8m (H1 2025 £47.1m); EBITDA +20.9% to £30.7m; 499 net new machines (8,106 total); now 38.4% of group vending revenue and 53.9% of group EBITDA — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Photo.ME H1 vending revenue −6.2% to £77.6m (H1 2025 £82.7m); EBITDA −8.1% to £27.2m; drivers include Germany photo-ID regulation, yen weakness, April travel-related weakness; photobooth estate 30,356 units (−201 YoY) — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

H2-to-date recovery: May 2026 total vending revenue +11.1% vs May 2025 (Wash.ME +25.9%, Photo.ME +1.8%); positive trend continued in June; France trading improved since April; laundry back to first-five-months levels; photobooth only partially recovered — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Gross cash £52.8m at 30 Apr 2026 (H1 2025 £66.4m restated); net cash £7.5m (H1 2025 £27.6m), excluding £10.0m lease liabilities; net cash fell from £26.5m at 31 Oct 2025 — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt
Group reports net cash, not net debt; financial liabilities on balance sheet £31.8m non-current and £23.6m current at 30 Apr 2026 — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt
Cash generated from operations £38.7m H1 2026 (−18.9% vs £47.7m H1 2025), driven by working capital (inventory +£8.3m); net cash from operating activities £32.2m — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt
Interim dividend declared 3.60p (−6.5% vs 3.85p H1 2025), returning £13.5m; payable 27 Nov 2026; dividends paid in H1 period £14.5m (prior-year interim) — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

H1 cash generation (£38.7m) comfortably covers declared interim dividend (£13.5m), but net cash position reduced after capex (£33.9m), dividends paid (£14.5m), tax (£5.1m) and buybacks (£2.7m) — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Revised FY26 guidance: profit before tax £69m–£74m; management repeatedly states on track to meet revised full-year expectations; Board takes cautious view but confident in laundry expansion — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt
Original (pre-revision) FY26 PBT guidance not restated in this interim report — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

ASDA partnership: largest laundry partnership in group history; first machine installed in June 2026; ambition up to 700 machines long term; large-scale H2 rollout planned; no H1 revenue contribution quantified — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt
Other partnerships: Aldi Austria pilot (25 laundry + 25 photobooths); France SNCF (5-year) and RATP (7-year) renewals together >£9.0m revenue — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

Dividend policy unchanged: committed to annual dividends of more than 55% of annual profits after tax, subject to market and capital requirements; new £18.0m share buyback launched March 2026 (£4.5m spent to date post-period) — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt

H1 capex £33.9m vs £28.8m H1 2025 (+17.7%); 68% on laundry (£14.9m) and photobooth (£8.2m); c.800 laundry installations planned H2 to reach ~1,300 FY target; no explicit change to capex policy stated — source: ac9d0c965a93c3fd.txt
